<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 193.1103. Assuming this is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is ≈192.103 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈12 % M+1) suggests about ten carbon atoms. A formula that matches the exact mass and the carbon count is C₁₀H₈O₄ (exact monoisotopic mass 192.0423 Da, within typical instrument tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C10H8O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H8O4</final_answer>
